description.narrative: The project aims to contribute to the empowerment and social inclusion of vulnerable women in the Bekaa region by strengthening their access to foundational skills, knowledge, and livelihood opportunities. Building on WND’s experience in implementing community-based protection and empowerment initiatives, the project will provide structured and continuous English language training, digital literacy skills, hygiene material production workshops, psychosocial support, and group-based micro-business development. These complementary components are designed to enhance women’s self-reliance, confidence, and ability to navigate both the economic and social challenges resulting from Lebanon’s ongoing crisis. Activities will be implemented over a 12-month period: - English sessions to women and girls. - Digital learning sessions to women and girls. - Soap making classes to be provided to women with an integrated financial literacy component during the final three sessions. - Group and Individual psychosocial support. - Women and girls will attend workshops on: • small business ideation and community-based market analysis. • budgeting, pricing, and financial planning for small businesses. • product branding, marketing, and digital promotion. Women and girls who attend the workshops will be supported to form collaborative micro-business groups, then will receive tailored seed funding and mentorship to pilot their micro-enterprises and finally the groups participate in a final exhibition where they present their products and business concepts to community members, local market actors, and other participants from the project.
